heroHeadline: Day 1037: Government Tells Court No October 7 Probe Before Oct 27 Election — No Sitting State Comptroller Since Jul 5 Court Defiance; Hamas Qassam Command Still Vacant
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. August 9, 2026 (Day 1037 / Ceasefire Day 304): Israel's October 7 accountability crisis has deepened into open institutional defiance. On July 5, 2026, Netanyahu's Cabinet voted to defy a High Court ruling for the first time in Israeli history (on the broadcast media regulator), while Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana simultaneously confirmed he would not hold the Court-ordered revote of Michael Rabello's tainted state comptroller election — leaving Israel with no sitting comptroller, and therefore no official empowered to audit government conduct on October 7, since that Sunday. All living former Supreme Court chief justices called this 'the final nail in the coffin of democracy.' The Knesset formally dissolved July 17 in a final legislative blitz that left the Kallner October 7 inquiry bill stalled after only its first reading. On July 22, the government told the High Court it could not complete the legislation before the October 27 election, drawing accusations of 'contempt for the court, the rule of law, and the Israeli public' from the October Council of bereaved and hostage families. On August 8, Ruby and Hagit Chen — parents of slain hostage Itay Chen — rallied at Habima Square urging voters to back only parties pledging a state commission of inquiry. Hamas's Al-Qassam Brigades supreme command has now been publicly vacant for more than 10 weeks since the IDF killed Mohammed Odeh on May 27; Imad Aqel remains the last identified senior October 7 planner still alive and the NILI task force's primary target. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. October 7 Perpetrators Eliminated: Sinwar (Oct 16, 2024), Shambari (Apr 29, 2026), Haddad (May 16, 2026), Odeh (May 27, 2026). Accountability: no state commission of inquiry established nearly three years after the attack; election set for October 27, 2026.
